app.title: Amika settings
app.hostOnly: Open settings on the host computer.
provider.title: Providers
provider.keyHelp: The key is sent only when saved, then cleared. A server environment key takes precedence.
provider.deleteKey: Delete stored credentials when changing service origin
slot.title: Provider roles
tts.selectionHelp: Automatic mode chooses one Fish emotion per AI reply while keeping the avatar expression. The mappings below are fallbacks when the reply has no valid speech emotion; fixed messages always use them. This choice works independently of spoken style.
tts.neutralExperimental: The gentle, warm tag for netral is experimental; compare its sound with a core tag.
tts.maxChars: Maximum characters in a merged sentence group
tts.debugHelp: Diagnostics include spoken text and tags. Audio and credentials are never recorded.
tts.emotionPresetsHelp: Choose up to two Fish tags for each avatar emotion. These are fallbacks in automatic mode and the primary tags in mapped mode. Basic and Advanced presets share the same sentence tag limit.
test.slow: First response exceeded the selected threshold.
test.missingModels: Models unavailable ({code}); enter the model manually.
warning.http: HTTP/WS traffic is unencrypted. Use only a trusted local or private network service.
warning.plaintext: Keys are stored without encryption because plaintext storage was explicitly enabled.
warning.secretStorage: Secret storage could not be read. Check Diagnostics before saving credentials.
warning.recovered: Corrupt settings were backed up and reset. Review the current provider assignments.
warning.windowsFirst: Windows-first: a native encrypted store is unavailable here. Use server environment keys or explicitly opt into plaintext.
warning.credentials: This JSON appears to contain credentials. Values will be stored as secrets; the field is cleared after submission.
warning.preset: The maintainer must verify this example endpoint before release.
privacy.intro: The following data is sent when its feature is used. Hosts come from current settings.
diagnostics.help: Uses a temporary random value in a separate folder; does not alter your keys.
diagnostics.acl: Windows ACLs have not been inspected. Keep the local directory private to your account.
diagnostics.readOnly: Environment storage is read-only; a write test is unavailable.
wizard.title: First-run setup
wizard.finished: Setup complete. You can change connections at any time.
wizard.chatRequired: Assign a chat provider and model to continue.
confirm.delete: Delete provider {id}? Its assigned roles will be unassigned.
confirm.origin: Delete old credentials and switch to the new service origin?
error.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving again.
error.origin: Service origin changed. Enter a replacement key or confirm deletion of old credentials.
error.inUse: This provider is still assigned to a role.
error.forbidden: Access denied. Open settings on the host computer and reload.
error.auth: Check the key and service permissions.
error.rate: Too many requests. Wait one minute.
error.timeout: The deadline expired. Check connectivity or increase the test deadline.
error.lockBusy: Another writer is active or its lock is recent. Wait and retry.
error.lockUnknown: Lock ownership is unknown. Stop other writers and inspect the lock locally.
error.lockRecovery: Lock recovery is active or interrupted. Retry; if it persists, stop all writers and inspect the recovery guard locally.
error.readOnly: Secret storage is read-only. Use server environment variables.
error.invalid: Check fields, JSON, URL and numeric bounds.
error.network: The server could not be reached.
error.generic: The operation failed. Check the code and provider status.
